name: Templated shared-memory idiom
description: A C++ template kernel needing a dynamically-sized extern __shared__ array of its own type T, obtained via the SharedMemory<T> template-specialization workaround; instantiated for int and float, computing out[i]=in[i]*num_threads.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: SharedMemory<T> template (+ specializations) and testKernel<T> reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples sharedmem.cuh and simpleTemplates.cu. Host driver, gen_idata, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Snapshot sk-14.
notes: Real-extraction template/shared-memory case from collection snapshot sk-14. N=256; output = int block (i*256) then float block (i*256), same values twice. Exact oracle.
